sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these is used to make a singing sound?
What type of instrument do you hit with your hands or sticks to make a sound?
Which facial expression shows happiness during a dance performance?
What do we call a story that is told through body movements and music without speaking?
Which of these sounds is usually slow and calming?
How do dancers mostly show anger or power through their footwork?
Which instrument produces sound by pressing black and white keys?
What is a song that tells a descriptive story called?
Which of the following is considered a string instrument?

options: A) The colors on the stage
B) The beat or timing pattern
questions.answer: B) The beat or timing pattern

questions.question_text: How can you make three different sounds using only your hands and feet? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I can clap my hands together for a sharp smack, snap my fingers for a tiny click, and stomp my feet heavily for a deep thud.

questions.question_text: Describe how a slow, sad song makes you feel and want to move. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A slow, sad song makes me feel quiet and sleepy. It makes me want to sway gently from side to side with my eyes closed.

questions.question_text: Name two musical instruments you blow into and describe their sounds. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A flute makes a high, sweet, and airy sound. A trumpet makes a very loud, bright, and powerful brassy sound that can be heard from far away.

questions.question_text: Why is facial expression important when telling a story through dance? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Facial expressions are important because they show the feelings of the character. A big smile shows joy, while a frown helps the audience understand sadness without words.

questions.question_text: What sounds do you hear in a busy park, and how are they like a song? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I hear birds chirping, children laughing, and leaves rustling. Together, they create a lively, happy pattern of noises that sounds like a natural, joyful song.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are dancing like a gentle river flowing down a mountain. Describe your movements. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would start by wiggling my fingers to show small drops of water. Then, I would glide smoothly across the floor, swaying my arms side to side to look like gentle waves. I would twirl softly to show the water winding around the mountain rocks.

questions.question_text: Imagine you invent a new musical instrument using things from your kitchen. Describe what it looks like and how you play it. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: My instrument is made of four different sized metal pots tied to a wooden broomstick. It has colorful rubber bands stretched over the open tops. I play it by plucking the rubber bands and tapping the metal sides with two wooden cooking spoons to make bright, bouncy beats.

questions.question_text: How would you use your body, face, and voice to act like an angry lion waking up? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would start by crouching low to the ground and stretching my arms out slowly with tense muscles. My face would show a deep frown with my teeth bare and eyes wide. I would let out a low, rumbling growl that turns into a loud roar as I stand up tall and swipe my paws.

questions.question_text: Describe a dance routine that tells the story of a seed growing into a big tree in the sunlight. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would begin by curling up in a tiny ball on the floor like a sleeping seed. As the imaginary sun shines, I would slowly raise my head and stretch one arm up like a sprout. Gradually, I would stand up, stretching both arms wide like strong branches, and sway gently in the warm breeze.
